svg.text: Actual directed worst native hops (representative bit of each group)
Purple: node/tree staging. Orange: ROM/weight pipeline. Blue: X/TX data. Green dashed: reset.
Why the right-side NODE can be sensible
Actual a/b/y/t_out pins are all on its W face, toward the data-stage banks.
Its clock/reset pins are on E. A MY flip would reverse both data and clock faces;
it needs legal-orientation, real pin, obstacle and compensated-phase admission.
Unknown hardware and routes are explicit — no invented XY or zero-area credit
Residual root 84: actual 2278 bit-mapped DFFs; control/metadata/RNE/gating comb and physical home unqualified.
Native outer pin ABI, all parent clock phases, unrepresented endpoints, RC/TT/FF/DRC and full programme remain open.
This tile drawing does not represent the complete 956-root compute or KV/IO system.
Known payload: 31,507 semantic LEF pairs; minimum +15.44948 ps, 0 failing groups.
Reset: 72 targets, minimum +48.91437 ps; no residual placeholder credited.
Arrows show actual pin-center direction, not routed tracks. Activity/cuts outside this local source scope remain unknown.
